component.subject: Illumination
component.title: Prayer for Illumination
component.author: Augustine
component.source: Augustine, Confessions, book XI, chapter 2, translated by J. G. Pilkington, in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, first series, vol. 1 (1886), p. 164. https://ccel.org/ccel/schaff/npnf101.vi.XI.II.html Modernised.

original.p: Let Thy Scriptures be my chaste delights. Neither let me be deceived in them, nor deceive out of them. Lord, hear and pity, O Lord my God, light of the blind, and strength of the weak; even also light of those that see, and strength of the strong, hearken unto my soul, and hear it crying out of the depths.

block.p: Lord, let your Scriptures be my chaste delight. Let me neither be deceived in them, nor deceive out of them. Lord, hear and have mercy, O Lord my God, light of the blind and strength of the weak, light also of those who see and strength of the strong; listen to my soul and hear it crying out of the depths.
